hypothesis: The existing two-family C06 breadth/BTC.D permission may add relative ETH vs BTC forecast information beyond the independent Task2 A no-drift anchor. C07 remains frozen. Do not infer negative drift from absence of permission.

model_proposal.baseline: Task2 A frozen BTC/ETH P0 and volatility; C0 original CN daily expected close
model_proposal.relative_tilt: Candidate for review: positive C06 permission only; symmetric opposite log-price shift preserving geometric midpoint; scale bounded by existing Task2 B 0.5 coefficient and smaller of A hourly sigmas; zero drift when verified permission false, abstain when source unavailable. Exact formula, clocks and implementation must be frozen in reviewed follow-up before activation.
model_proposal.sequence_role: Separate preregistered diagnostic; do not treat observed crossing as confirmed sequence.

fixture_formula.relative_log_drift: 0.5 * min(sigma_BTC_hourly,sigma_ETH_hourly) * sqrt(24) * h/24 if C06 true; zero if verified false; abstain if unavailable
fixture_formula.band_shift: multiply existing A quantile endpoints by exp(asset_log_shift); preserves logarithmic width, not calibrated coverage
fixture_formula.activation: rejects any A source other than explicit synthetic fixture; no live issuance interface

activation.required: Reviewed immutable main contract/code and original source known-by evidence before first forecast issue; first actual consumer delivery recorded; no historical backfill
activation.historical_data_use: 2026-W47 and earlier/current exposed outcomes are exploratory only; never confirmatory C2

evaluation.primary: Paired daily close normalized MAE vs A no-drift; separate BTC and ETH and relative ratio
evaluation.cohort: Same decision cutoff, original source clocks, outcome path and availability across candidates; report abstentions; eight resolved week clusters proposed subject to review

fixture_harness.matched_population: both BTC and ETH must have all original A scored hours; whole-day exclusion for late delivery, unmatured day, missing either asset or unavailable permission
fixture_harness.relative_target: implied ETH/BTC spot close ratio from identical paired close times; no separately timestamped ratio
fixture_harness.metrics: normalized close MAE, direction including FLAT, close and full-range coverage, original A primary interval score and width, all with identical denominators
fixture_harness.guard: no real issuance, no historical C2 score, no independent sample or edge, synthetic delivery clock unverified
